product.title: Ride Boulder's Best Guided eBike E-Bike Tour! Electric eBike

description.text: Enjoy Boulder's natural beauty, iconic landmarks and major attractions all from a pedal-assist electric bike. After a short tutorial, we'll head out on the trails to cover the historic Pearl Street pedestrian mall, the CU Boulder campus, Wonderland Lake, Boulder Creek and more! Stops include University of Colorado at Boulder, The Hill, The Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse, Hotel Boulderado, Flatirons, Folsom Field. This is a great activity for solo visitors, groups and families to see town in an active, fun and memorable way. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
